name: Percentage Range 1 Choice
definition: Choice between ranges of rates in which a percentage rate is considered valid or a specified percentage rate which has to be matched or unmatched to be valid.

From.name: From
From.definition: Lower boundary of a range of percentage rates.

To.name: To
To.definition: Upper boundary of a range of percentage rates.

Equal.name: Equal
Equal.definition: Exact percentage rate must match to be considered valid.

NotEqual.name: Not Equal
NotEqual.definition: Value that percentage rate must not match to be considered valid.
